deviation: The 1x cap is in line with the standard, but Section 9.3 doesn't carve out IP infringement indemnity or breach of confidentiality, which the playbook requires to be uncapped. Those claims are therefore capped at 1x fees and also hit by the indirect loss and lost profits exclusion in 9.2. Section 9.3 also leaves gross negligence and willful misconduct uncapped, which goes beyond the playbook's permitted uncapped categories and exposes Arcadia as well. The cap is also measured on fees in the 12 months before the claim, so it could be lower early in the term.
suggested_text: 9.1 Cap. Subject to Section 9.3, each Party's total aggregate liability arising under this Agreement shall not exceed one (1) times the annual Fees paid or payable. 9.2 Exclusion of Indirect Loss. Subject to Section 9.3, neither Party is liable for indirect or consequential loss arising out of this Agreement. 9.3 Exceptions. Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes either Party's liability for (a) fraud; (b) its indemnification obligations for infringement of third-party intellectual property rights; (c) breach of confidentiality obligations; or (d) any liability that cannot be limited under applicable law. 9.4 Insurance. Ironbridge shall maintain throughout the Term, with reputable insurers, insurance cover of at least USD 5,000,000 per claim, and shall provide evidence of coverage on Arcadia's reasonable request.
